notes.title: Day one patch for the Great Meow-Meow !
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38762699/2eaa7267d4b421b2af988beed3cdd91728063704.png

Let It Go Version 1.27 fixes :

-The riddle of the water stone now has a little clue as to which way to look at the pattern to memorize.
-The button change language is now in the game menu and no longer in the graphics menu.
-The spelling error corrected.
-The cheat of the jump in the pool - which was originally intended as a trick that accompanies a run, and not on which to base your Hope recovery - is now reduced to once per run, (the little angel will specify this in his 9th dialogue) 
-Added a tombstone in the ground

Thank for your feedbacks, the Great Meow-Meow is rising !

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38762699/2d6ec2251d4185d5340efd98ed8604839b59362f.png

notes.title: Let It Go is born !
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=m0pdVRHarO0;full][/previewyoutube]
Let It Go is born !

We hope that you will enjoy it, and that its philosophical message will resonate with your soul.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38762699/2eaa7267d4b421b2af988beed3cdd91728063704.png

In this package : 

- the full game
- the speedrun mode (if you unlock it)
- the access to a private discord (if you unlock it)

We hope you the best,

Philozofia Studio
